findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: There is observed a spill in the bottom of the refrigerator in the kitchen. PIC was made aware of the spill and immediately cleaned it up. Ensure that areas are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil debris and will need to be cleaned:
-the air vent in in the kitchen is observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris forming on the ceiling.
-the air return underneath the yogurt cooler is observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris.
These surfaces need to be cleaned and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: The waffle forks are observed to be stored directly on the counter surface in front of the waffle makers. Inspector spoke with PIC and they will be utilizing a barrier on the counter to store the waffle forks on. Ensure that the food contact surface of the utensil is stored in a manner that prevents contamination during storage, preparation, and display. 
3-304.12FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: Two boxes of single service cups are stacked on the floor. Store single service items at least 6" off the floor.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) and (C)  (C) Single-Use Articles are stored incorrectly. Single-Use Articles shall be stored: 1) in a clean and dry location; 2) away or protected from contamination; 3) at least six inches above the floor; 4) covered or inverted. Reference 4-903.11(A) and (C).

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Facility is not sanitizing. Previous employee had trained new employee that this was not needed. When washing dishes, they must be washed in warm soapy water, rinsed in plain warm water, and sanitized in sanitizer solution before being air dried. Facility has bleach and test strips available (it is not an FDA Food Code approved bleach which will be needed as on Page 2). A bus tub or some other method to set up a third compartment will be needed for this as well. No sanitizer bucket was available either. Provide a sanitizer bucket for rags used to clean tables and other clean in place items (such as handles to microwave and cooler, etc).
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
White powders were observed with no labels. Label white powders with the common name of product.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed food debris in the reach in freezer. Clean freezer.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The counter top was separating from the wall in the corner next to the coffee makers. Reseal counter top to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: No thermometer in the Haier cooler on the breakfast line. Provide a thermometer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Coffee filters were stored on top of coffee pot. Store coffee filters in a closed container.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a wet wiing cloth on the counter in the kitchen. Store wet wiping cloth in sanitizer in between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following food contact areas to be soiled: 1)top of the microwave in the kitchen and at the breakfast bar with food debris 2)can opener with food debris. Wash, rinse, and sanitize food contact areas.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed knives in the breakfast bar area with the food contact surfaces stored up. Store knives with the handle extended out.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Two squirt bottles of syrup on the food bar were unlabeled as to their contents.  Label the contents of both bottles.

750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
1. Fruit in a bowl in the breakfast bar was 51 degrees.  The manager stated that they usually re-refrigerate the left over fruit.  Since the fruit was out of temperature, it will be discarded at 10 a.m. to CORRECT the violation.  See comments in HACCP TOPIC on page two for more information.

2.  Sausage, scrambled eggs, milk, etc. in the refrigerator were 46 degrees.  They were moved to a cooler across the street at Northfield Center to CORRECT the violation until the refrigerator can be repaired.   Keep the sausage and eggs at 41 degrees or less.

3.  An opened bag of pre-cooked sausage was not dated as to when the bag was opened.   Another pan of food was not dated as to when the food was prepared or the date it was to be used 7 days later.  The food was dated as to when it was prepared to CORRECT the violation.

750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment:
The refrigerator portion of the refrigerator/freezer was keeping food at 46 degrees.  Repair the refrigerator.

750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The can opener blade was soiled. The opener was put in the dish machine to clean and sanitize it to CORRECT the violation.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1.  A fly swatter was stored on top of the microwave.  The swatter was moved to a location away from food, food handling equipment, etc. to correct the violation.

2.  The inside of the refrigerator part of the refrigerator/freezer was soiled with spilled food.  The soiled shelves were cleaned to CORRECT the violation.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The vent cover in the wall inside the cabinet under the cereal dispensers in the food bar was soiled.  Clean the vent cover.

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - A) Cream cheese and whipped spread packets in the top cold holding containers were 46F-58F respectively. Packets with questionable temperatures were discarded in the trash. The packets further down in the container were at 41F/below. Keep packets ~1inch below the top inner ledge of the cold holding containers to ensure proper temperature is maintained for all products. B) Whipped spread packets in bottom of fridge were +50F. All whipped spread packets were discarded in the trash. Maintain cold potentially hazardous foods at 41F/below.  (see general comments)

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - (R) Bowl of canned fruit was uncovered in dining area. Provide a cover for the fruit bowl (i.e. plastic wrap) or replace with a container that has a cover built in to protect the product from potential contamination. Foods shall be protected at all times. Properly cover foods.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Sanitizer solution for general surfaces was less than 100ppm chlorine (~50-75ppm). Solution was remade and tested at 100ppm. Maintain sanitizing solution at 100ppm - use test strips to verify proper concentration is maintained. Be care with the temperature of the water used to make the solution. If it is too hot it will cause the bleach to dissipate out of the solution. Change the solution every 2-4 hours or more often if the solution and rags become heavily soiled.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The can opener blade had dried on food debris. Also the crevice around the blade and the handle had sticky buildup. Properly clean and sanitize the can opener and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800be - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside cabinet used for storage or gravy mix; B) bottom compressor area and cover to fridge freezer unit (heavy dust buildup); C) fridge/freezer unit = bottom inside fridge & inside door to freezer; D) bottom inside upright freezer; & E) counter in kitchen behind coffee pot. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - A) (R) Coffee and tea filters were stored food surface up in the kitchen. Invert filters or place in sealed containers or a plastic food grade bag. B) Plastic knives were observed with food surfaces extended up. Store all plastic utensils with the handles extended up out of storage containers. C) Boxes of cups were observed on the ground behind the door in the dining area. Store all single service items elevated up off the ground at least 6 inches. Boxes were moved during the inspection. Store single service items so they are protected from potential contamination.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) (R) Walls and vent cover inside slatted door cabinet at breakfast counter had dust buildup. The door and seal around the door were also soiled. Clean the walls, vent cover, and all surfaces inside the cabinet as well as the door daily/as needed. B) Drawer with serving utensils was rough and needs to be re-sealed. Paint or replace the bottom of the drawer. C) Pitcher storage cabinet had spots where the finish has peeled off. Re-seal the bottom of the pitcher storage cabinet.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - A) Bowl of canned fruit was uncovered in dining area. Provide a cover for the fruit bowl or replace with a container that has a cover built in to protect the product from potential contamination. B) Tube of bulk milk was cut straight across. Cut the bulk milk tube at an approx. 45 degree angle/1 inch in length to prevent puddling of milk/potential cross contamination of customer/employee drinks. Foods shall be protected at all times.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - Drawer below coffee makers in kitchen was rough/had chipped paint. Repaint the drawer.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - Inside black crock pot and 2 tray covers in storage cabinet were soiled. Properly clean/sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. **Get rid of unused/damaged equipment.**

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - A) Bowls were stored food surface up by fruit bowl in dining area. D) Coffee and tea filters were stored food surface up in the kitchen. Store single service items covered and inverted to protect food surfaces from potential contamination.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.citation_text: 750.1120(b) - (NEW) Employee was observed using both parts of 2 part sinks for various tasks. One side must be designated for handwashing only and used for no other tasks. This was discussed during the routine inspection conducted on 4/19/11. Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times. Proper use of handsink/handwashing was discussed with management during the inspection.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - Walls and vent cover inside slatted door cabinet have been cleaned since the routine inspection; however buildup was present again today. Clean the walls, vent cover, and all surfaces inside the cabinet daily/as needed.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Bowl of canned fruit was uncovered in dining area. Foods shall be protected at all times. Provide a cover for the fruit bowl or replace with a container that has a cover built in to protect the product from potential contamination.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.650 - Plastic blue spatula and wire whisk were observed to be in disrepair. The spatula had grooves in it and a chunk missing. The whisk had broken segments. Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices. Whisk and spatula were discarded in the trash during the inspection. **Once food contact surfaces get worn to the point that they can not be properly cleaned/sanitized they must be replaced.**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Drawer and cabinet below coffee maker and bean grinder in the kitchen were in disrepair due to previous leaks from the coffee maker. There were some rough and water damaged areas. B) Juncture at the counter and the wall behind coffee makers and grinder in kitchen had a significant gap. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Properly seal the counter wall juncture and repair or replace the drawer/cabinets.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Wet wiping cloths were observed on the faucet and counter in the kitchen. When asked about sanitizing solution, the employee on duty stated rags are rinsed in the sink/hot water is used for wiping general surfaces. Sanitizer solution (100ppm chlorine) must be used for wiping general surfaces, and wet cloths must be stored in the solution between uses to inhibit the growth of microorganisms. Employee made sanitizer solution during the inspection and placed the wet cloths inside.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) bottom inside toaster (heavy crumb buildup); B) inside black crock pot; & C) top inside kitchen microwave (dried food splash). Wash, rinse, and sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of food and other debris. **Serving utensils used for potentially hazardous foods requiring temperature control need to be left in the foods with handles extended up out of product. If it is not possible to store utensils in this way, make sure utensils are cleaned/sanitized up to every 4 hours (breakfast served 6-10am).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) all cabinets and drawers in kitchen and dining area (crumbs, old mouse droppings/gnawings in a few locations, & general debris); B) counters - under/behind coffee grinder, coffee makers, & microwaves; C) inside bulk milk dispenser; D) inside freezer of fridge/freezer unit (crumbs/hair); E) bottom of standup freezer (behind black cover - dust buildup); & F) bottom inside freezer in mini store. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of
dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - Drawers and cabinets w/ clean utensils and dishes were in general soiled. Extra dishes and utensils were soiled in these areas. Cleaned and sanitized utensils and equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Clean/sanitize the dishes and utensils in the kitchen cabinets and drawers. Keep storage areas clean to protect items from contamination.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - A) Plastic cups were observed in drawer below microwave in kitchen. Drawer had old droppings in it. All cups were discarded in the trash. B) Box of foam plates was observed on the floor behind the door of the dining area. Box was moved during the inspection. C) Bowls were stored food surface up by fruit bowl in dining area. D) Coffee and tea filters were store food surface up in the kitchen. E) Containers holding plasticware had crumbs in them & knives were observed with handles and food surfaces intermixed. Single-service articles shall be stored and dispensed in a way that protects them from contamination. Properly store single service articles.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Walls and vent cover inside slatted door cabinet were heavily soiled w/ dust buildup (area inside cabinet below Fruit Loops and Raisin Bran at breakfast counter). Clean the walls and the vent cover inside the cabinet.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
750-120 At all times food shall be protected from potential contamination. Provide sneeze guard for salad/food bar.
Can opener is shedding filings that can potentially contaminate produce being opened.  Food must be protected from contraminatikon at all times.  Discontinue use of canopener until repaired.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:

Equipment, utensils, and single-service articles shall not impart odors, color, or taste, nor contribute to the contamination of food.
Can opener blade is worn.  Mulri-use equipment shall be maintained.  Replace blade.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
Underside of juice dispenser is soiled with dries juice.  Non food contact surfaces must be kept clean.  Clean surface and keep clean.
Counter under microwave is soiled.  Clean and keep clean.
Cupboards in kitchen are soiled.  Clean and keep clean.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.
.Styrofoam plates are stored eating surface up.  Invert plates to keep from being contaminated.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.
Waste container is women's toilet room is not covered.  Covered waste containers shall be provided for waste materials.  Provide covered waste container for women's toilet room.
